mentions.name: Wildflower Witness
mentions.description: This tool groups wildflower photographs into time series, with an open design question between letting users create each flower in their collection manually or doing it fully automatically.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm photographing wildflowers so much that I made a tool called Wildflower Witness to group the images into time series. I'm debating if I want to allow the user to create each flower in their collection or try to do it totally automatically.
